summary: Frontend-only verification of new DETAILED CHECKLIST feature (pemeriksaan + imunisasi question types). All 4 scenarios PASS: (1) BUMIL_K1..K6 render as pemeriksaan cards with data-testid q-BUMIL_K{n} and tanggal/tempat/petugas inputs — verified all 6 present in ibu_hamil checklist step. (2) BAYI_IMUN_DETAIL renders as imunisasi card with 17 vaccine toggle chips (BAYI_IMUN_DETAIL-vax); toggling first chip flips class to include 'emerald' (green selected state). BAYI_KN1..KN3 pemeriksaan cards also present. (3) Persistence: after wizard submit, GET /api/kunjungan/{id} returns per_anggota[].answers containing BUMIL_K1={tanggal,tempat,petugas}, BAYI_KN1={tanggal,tempat,petugas}, BAYI_IMUN_DETAIL={'Usia 0 bulan':{'Hepatitis B (<24 jam)': true}}. (4) No regression: submit succeeds with only optional detail answers filled, toast 'Laporan kunjungan terkirim!' shown, wizard exits to Beranda; findings/temuan remain empty (detail questions have no problem_when so never fire).
critical_code_review_comments: QuestionField.js: 'imunisasi' section reuses same data-testid `${q.kode}-vax` for every chip — OK for count/toggle testing but consumers can't target a specific vaccine chip; consider adding a per-chip suffix like `${q.kode}-vax-${row.usia}-${v}` for granular tests.
QuestionField.js: date input `max` set to today prevents selecting future ANC dates; acceptable for historical logging but not for scheduled visits (feature intent seems historical — fine).

Wizard.js ChecklistStep orders members by original anggota array order, so the checklist step-order depends on family structure (bayi came before ibu_hamil for 'Budi Santoso 1'). Not a bug but worth documenting.
Server evaluate_answers correctly skips q.problem_when=[] so pemeriksaan/imunisasi never create temuan — confirmed prioritas='hijau' and temuan=[] on submitted kunjungan.
seed_data_creation: One kunjungan created for family 73c42ad4-5147-448b-aa05-4325fc1fb78e (Budi Santoso 1) with 2 members (ibu_hamil, bayi) containing BUMIL_K1, BAYI_KN1 pemeriksaan and BAYI_IMUN_DETAIL imunisasi answers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For Budi Santoso 1: bayi anggota (id 249ceb9f-...) is index 0 → its checklist appears as step 3; ibu_hamil (id 9e477fb1-...) is index 3 → its checklist appears as step 4. Total wizard steps with both selected = 6 (confirm, select, bayi-checklist, ibu-checklist, ringkasan, edukasi, kirim = 7 dynamic). Kader GET /api/kunjungan?keluarga_id=... returns 403 — use plain GET /api/kunjungan then filter client-side (or use admin token).
